text:
A small model solves a Sudoku
by thinking in loops.

Every pixel is a different first thought.
Same puzzle, same model.

Colour: how many loops it takes
to settle on its answer.

Zoom in. Neighbouring thoughts,
different journeys.

Two neighbouring thoughts, one answer:
{a_settle} loops against {b_settle}.

{wob} sits in the speckle: re-runs with a 1e-6 nudge
give {wob_lo} to {wob_hi} loops.
